scope: Large public sculpture from the second half of the twentieth century onward. Approved for publication on 7 September 2026.
rights_note: Per-model CC BY licenses are recorded from current primary metadata. They apply to the 3D files; underlying artwork rights and credited artists remain separate.
archive: Public Objaverse 1.0 GLBs from allenai/objaverse on Hugging Face; each source is matched by Sketchfab UID and hashed.

works.title: Ancestor I
works.museum: University of Birmingham, Research and Cultural Collections
works.capture: Independent scan of the sculpture at the University of Birmingham.
preparation: Baked node transforms into geometry to make camera bounds tight while preserving shape and pose.
Optimized geometry for web display; maximum texture edge 2048 pixels, WebP and meshopt compression.
works.attribution: Ancestor I, Barbara Hepworth. 3D model by kjeywhat, CC BY 4.0. © Bowness / Hepworth Estate Atrium derivative: geometry and textures optimized for browser display.

orientation.note: Upright bronze sections and base verified; camera faces the side with the base plaque, matching the source reference.

excluded_candidates.title: Tumbleweed
excluded_candidates.reason: The available archive has extensive missing sculpture geometry and no textures; local render confirms the scan is not suitable.

excluded_candidates.title: Tower (DC)
excluded_candidates.reason: Both scans show only a small fragment of the concrete-block work. Other found models were small reconstructions or wall details.
No usable, openly downloadable full sculpture scan found. Public Courtauld Fulcrum page contains a photograph, not a model; SketchUp results explicitly describe guesswork from photos.

excluded_candidates.title: Angel of the North
excluded_candidates.reason: Video-derived photogrammetry. Removing surrounding scenery revealed major holes at both wing tips; excluded after local review.

excluded_candidates.title: Spider
excluded_candidates.reason: Low-quality room capture obscures the sculpture.

excluded_candidates.title: Locking Piece, Duisburg
excluded_candidates.reason: Available scan is the 106 cm working model, not the monumental version.

excluded_candidates.title: Estela de Gernika II
excluded_candidates.reason: 144 cm high; set aside to prioritize larger works.

excluded_candidates.title: LOVE, Shinjuku
excluded_candidates.reason: CC BY-NC-SA: held outside the commercial-safe catalog under COLLECTION-GROWTH.md.

excluded_candidates.title: Gate of Hope
excluded_candidates.reason: Student digital reconstruction based on a scan; retained as a research lead, not included as an actual scan.

excluded_candidates.title: Maternidade
excluded_candidates.reason: CC BY on current source, but no public archive file located in this pass.

excluded_candidates.title: Sun God
excluded_candidates.reason: Primary metadata credits Jorenne Flores with a model based on the statue, rather than identifying it as a scan. Local review shows an unfinished white reverse and omits the arch.
